correctness.rationale: The Voronoi cell is exactly x+y≥0,x+z≥0,y+z≥0 with area π (one of four partition cells). Using the globally orthonormal five harmonic quadratics Q0..Q4 and quartic product decomposition p=h4+r²h2+c r⁴ where c=Δ²p/120, h2=(Δp−20cr²)/14, integrate via spherical Green theorem over three great-circle edges. This yields the scalar Z=1/4+√3/(9π) and two identical (A,C;C,B) blocks with A=1/4+11√3/(54π), B=1/4−7√3/(27π), C=−√6/(27π). Eigenvalues simplify to above; 219>75 proves λ−<Z<λ+. Source exact_tetra_slepian.py performs symbolic boundary integrations and matrix assertions; independent numerical eigenmatrix check reproduces .103836526588684, .311258766157977, .365534090332327 and trace 5/4. The exact edge integrations, not numerical quadrature, prove the stated values.
